sub_graphs.title: Phase 0: LMD GHOST Fork Choice Weight Calculation
sub_graphs.description: Models the weight calculation mechanism including attestation scores and proposer boost that determines the canonical chain head

nodes.label: Fork Choice Store Initialized
nodes.description: The Store data structure is initialized with genesis block, justified and finalized checkpoints, and empty latest_messages map

nodes.label: Execute LMD GHOST Head Selection
nodes.description: Recursively select child block with greatest weight starting from justified checkpoint, considering attestation weight and proposer boost

nodes.label: Compute Attestation Weight for Block
nodes.description: Sum effective balances of active unslashed validators whose latest message supports this block (directly or through descendants)

nodes.label: Apply Proposer Score Boost
nodes.description: Add temporary weight boost of (committee_weight * 40 / 100) to the timely proposed block, where committee_weight = total_active_balance / SLOTS_PER_EPOCH

nodes.label: Chain Head Determined
nodes.description: The canonical chain head block has been selected via LMD GHOST traversal

nodes.label: Filter Block Tree by FFG Voting Source
nodes.description: Prune blocks whose unrealized justified checkpoint is not competitive with the store's justified checkpoint, ensuring only viable branches are considered

edges.label: Begin head selection by filtering viable blocks
Run LMD GHOST on filtered block tree
Calculate weight for each candidate child block
Add proposer boost if block was timely proposed
Highest-weight leaf is the chain head

sub_graphs.title: Phase 0: Fork Choice on_block Handler
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions that occur when a new block is received by the fork choice store

nodes.label: New Block Received
nodes.description: A signed beacon block has been received and needs to be processed by the fork choice

nodes.label: Check Parent Block Exists in Store
nodes.description: Verify the block's parent_root references a known block in the store

nodes.label: Check Block Not from Future
nodes.description: Verify the block's slot is not greater than the current slot derived from store time

nodes.label: Check Block Descends from Finalized
nodes.description: Verify the block is a descendant of the finalized checkpoint block

nodes.label: Apply Beacon State Transition
nodes.description: Execute state_transition on parent state with the new block to produce post-state

nodes.label: Record Block Timeliness
nodes.description: Check if block arrived within SECONDS_PER_SLOT / INTERVALS_PER_SLOT of its slot start to determine proposer boost eligibility

nodes.label: Update Justified and Finalized Checkpoints
nodes.description: Update the store's unrealized justified and finalized checkpoints based on the post-state, and potentially pull up realized checkpoints

nodes.label: Block Integrated into Fork Choice Store
nodes.description: Block and its post-state are stored, checkpoints updated, proposer boost potentially applied

edges.label: Block arrives from P2P network or local proposal
Record arrival time for proposer boost

external_entities.name: P2P Network / Local Validator
external_entities.description: Source of new beacon blocks, either from gossip or local block production

sub_graphs.title: Phase 0: Fork Choice on_attestation Handler
sub_graphs.description: Models how attestations update the fork choice store's latest messages and affect chain head selection

nodes.label: Attestation Received
nodes.description: An indexed attestation has been received for fork choice processing

nodes.label: Validate Attestation Target
nodes.description: Verify target epoch is current or previous epoch, target root is known in the store, and beacon block root is known

nodes.label: Check Target Root Consistency
nodes.description: Verify target_root equals the checkpoint block at the attestation's target epoch derived from beacon_block_root

nodes.label: Check Validator Not Equivocating
nodes.description: Skip updating latest_messages for validators marked as equivocating via on_attester_slashing

nodes.label: Update Validator Latest Message
nodes.description: Update the latest_messages entry for each attesting validator if the attestation epoch is newer than the stored message

nodes.label: Latest Messages Updated
nodes.description: Fork choice store's latest_messages reflect the new attestation data for non-equivocating validators

edges.label: Verify target root matches expected checkpoint
Update latest message if epoch is newer

external_entities.name: Attesting Validator
external_entities.description: A validator submitting an attestation about the chain head and justified/finalized checkpoints

sub_graphs.title: Phase 0: Fork Choice Reorg Conditions
sub_graphs.description: Models the optional head reorg mechanism where a proposer can re-org the current head under specific conditions

nodes.label: Proposer Evaluating Reorg Opportunity
nodes.description: The assigned block proposer checks whether conditions allow reorging the current head

nodes.label: Check Head Block Arrived Late
nodes.description: Verify the current head block was not received within the timeliness threshold

nodes.label: Check Head Has Weak Weight
nodes.description: Verify the head block's attestation weight is below a weakness threshold

nodes.label: Check Parent Has Strong Weight
nodes.description: Verify the head's parent block has sufficient weight to serve as the reorg base

nodes.label: Check FFG Information Competitive
nodes.description: Verify that building on the parent does not sacrifice justified/finalized checkpoints

nodes.label: Reorg Conditions Met
nodes.description: All reorg conditions satisfied; proposer builds on parent of current head instead of head

nodes.label: Normal Build on Head
nodes.description: Reorg conditions not met; proposer builds on current head as normal

edges.label: Head was late, check if also weak
Head is weak, check parent strength
Parent is strong, verify FFG safety

ambiguities.text: The proposer boost weight formula uses 'committee_weight * 40 / 100' but the exact rounding behavior for integer arithmetic is not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume integer floor division as is standard in Python and most beacon chain implementations.

ambiguities.text: The reorg conditions are described as 'optional implementation' leaving ambiguity about whether all clients should implement them for consensus safety.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume reorg logic is recommended but not consensus-critical; differing implementations should not cause chain splits.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not fully define the behavior when the store receives blocks for slots significantly in the past (deep reorgs).
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the finalized checkpoint descent check prevents deep reorgs; blocks not descending from finalized are rejected.

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes are assumed to have clocks synchronized within SECONDS_PER_SLOT duration for accurate timeliness judgments and proposer boost.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Desynchronized clocks could cause nodes to disagree on block timeliness, leading to inconsistent proposer boost application and potential temporary chain splits.

implicit_assumptions.description: It is assumed that an attacker controls less than 1/3 of the total active stake, ensuring the fork choice converges on a single canonical chain.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker with >= 1/3 stake could exploit proposer boost and attestation timing to perform balancing attacks, preventing finality.

implicit_assumptions.description: The store is assumed to persist across restarts or be reconstructable from finalized state, so that latest_messages are not lost.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Loss of latest_messages on restart would temporarily weaken fork choice accuracy until attestations are re-received.
